text: After discovering Heather's exceptional work on Instagram, I knew I had to book her for our wedding, and she exceeded all expectations. From the initial consultation to meeting her in person and witnessing her live painting during the wedding, the entire experience was nothing short of extraordinary. The final artwork was stunning, and we received numerous compliments both during and after the event, with many guests remarking that it was one of the most unique and memorable aspects of the wedding. It remains one of my favorite parts of our special day. I highly recommend Heather!

owner_reply.text: Wow, thank you so so much for taking the time to share all of this!! It was such an honor to be part of your wedding! I could totally see the love and joy you and Olivia share for each other and it was beautiful! Thank you for trusting me to paint your wedding!!! Sending my best to you both!! 💗🌸💗
